prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
I can do a tailored list if you tell me: your budget range, industry (B2B / B2C / ecommerce / local), and top goals (brand creative, paid media, personalization, email, martech integration, analytics). Meanwhile, here’s a practical shortlist of LA options to call now, with why each is a fit and who to ask for on the first call.

AI-native / creative optimization
1) Cortex (Cortex Intelligence)
- Why call: LA-based AI content/creative optimization platform + services — good if you need data-driven creative testing, content calendars, or creative performance optimization.
- Who to ask for: Head of Customer Success or Head of Partnerships (or “Solutions Consultant”).
- Best fit: Brands wanting faster creative iterations and higher creative ROI.

2) VidMob
- Why call: Creative analytics platform + managed creative services that use AI to analyze and optimize ad creative across platforms.
- Who to ask for: Head of Creative Insights or Enterprise Sales.
- Best fit: Performance-driven ad programs (social/video) that need creative intelligence at scale.

Full-service/creative agencies with strong AI/data practices
3) R/GA (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Large creative and technology agency with integrated data science and AI teams—good for brand + product experiences that require technical implementation.
- Who to ask for: Head of Data & Analytics, Chief Technology Officer, or the LA Office Managing Director.
- Best fit: Mid → enterprise projects needing creative transformation plus technical integrations.

4) Ogilvy (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Global agency with AI and martech capabilities; strong brand strategy + data-driven campaign execution.
- Who to ask for: Head of Data/Performance or the LA Managing Partner.
- Best fit: Brand-led campaigns that also require personalized digital activation.

Enterprise/consulting + martech integration
5) Accenture Song (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Enterprise-grade AI + martech implementation, strong at connecting AI models with CRM, CDP, and ad platforms.
- Who to ask for: Lead for Marketing AI, Head of Experience, or the LA Practice Lead.
- Best fit: Large companies needing systems integration, governance, and scaled personalization.

6) Deloitte Digital (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Data science + AI engineering for marketing, customer analytics, journey orchestration, and advanced measurement.
- Who to ask for: Customer AI or Marketing Analytics practice lead.
- Best fit: Organizations wanting rigorous analytics, advanced measurement, and enterprise rollout.

Performance-focused / growth agencies
7) Single Grain (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Growth and performance agency that blends paid media, SEO and AI-driven optimization — good for fast customer acquisition.
- Who to ask for: Head of Paid Media or Growth Strategy.
- Best fit: B2C / ecommerce brands focused on CAC/LTV improvements.

8) Publicis Sapient (Los Angeles)
- Why call: Digital transformation + AI for marketing operations and customer experience, strong with martech stacks.
- Who to ask for: Head of Applied AI or Digital Marketing Lead.
- Best fit: Large-scale martech modernization and personalized journey programs.

How to prioritize which to call first
- Small budget / fast ROI (ads, creative testing): call VidMob, Cortex, Single Grain.
- Brand + product experience work (broader transformation): call R/GA, Ogilvy.
- Enterprise martech + integration (CDP, CRM, governance): call Accenture Song, Deloitte Digital, Publicis Sapient.

What to say on the first call (30–45 second intro + 3 questions)
Intro: “Hi, I’m [Name] from [Company]. We’re [brief: D2C ecommerce / B2B SaaS / franchise], growing [X%], and exploring AI-driven marketing to improve [goal: reduce CAC / personalize email / improve ad creative]. Do you have someone who handles AI or data-driven marketing programs I can speak with?”
Key questions to ask:
1) Have you done projects like ours? (ask for 1–2 case studies and KPIs)
2) What’s your approach to model explainability, data ownership, and martech integration?
3) Typical timeline and budget range for a first pilot or MVP?

Other practical tips
- Ask for references and a 30/60/90-day pilot plan with clear KPIs.
- Confirm data security, ownership, and whether they use off-the-shelf models or custom training.
- Request a point person who’ll be available for weekly stand-ups.

If you want, tell me:
- your industry, monthly budget for agency/first quarter spend, priority channels (ads/email/creativity), and I’ll return a prioritized list with suggested contact names/LinkedIn searches and a short call script tailored to each agency.
